title: Umbral calculus over a vector space
summary: Let $V$ be a vector space over $\mathbb F=\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$. We develop a basis-free umbral calculus over $V$. We define the vector space of polynomials over $V$, and polynomial sequences in it. We discuss shift-invariant operators acting in polynomials over $V$. We define polynomial sequences of binomial type and Sheffer sequences over $V$. We provide equivalent characterizations of these polynomial sequences.
